title: Daodejing
subtitle: One of the key texts of Daoist thought
timeLabel: Composition and compilation: Warring States to Han ranges
shortSummary: The formation, compilation and attribution of the Daodejing have several historical layers, and later Daoist and philosophical traditions repeatedly reinterpreted it.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates textual formation, traditional attribution, chapter versions and later interpretation instead of treating ‘Laozi said’ as a single historical moment.
researchNote: Composition ranges, excavated materials and differences among received editions will be expanded through the full text-version model.
